hero.subtitle: Fonts, columns, tables, images — everything stays in place. As if the document was natively written in the target language.

features.title: Why choose Précis?
features.desc: Powerful tools for flawless translations, whatever the size of your team.
features.card_fidelity_desc: Translations faithful to meaning and context thanks to cutting-edge AI that understands cultural and stylistic nuances.
features.card_format_desc: Keep 100% of the structure and style of your Word, PowerPoint, and PDF files, without any manual manipulation.
features.card_security_desc: Your data is deleted within 24 hours. GDPR compliance guaranteed and no commercial retention of your documents.
features.card_human_desc: Ultra-fast AI translation systematically reviewed by certified human translators for flawless quality.
features.card_ocr_desc: Automatic OCR for scanned PDFs with printed French or English text, up to 10 pages per request. Review of the result recommended.
features.card_languages_desc: Cover all your markets with more than 50 language pairs available, from the most common to the most specialized.
